setup.bannerText: Finish your company infrastructure or schedule your first job when you are ready.
setup.welcomeLead: Welcome to JobRhythm{name}. The Admin Assistant will guide you through configuring the system for Residential Trade Contractors. Start with inventory, then essential masters, then your first field workflow.
setup.step1Message: Prepare your inventory for Florida residential electrical projects automatically.
setup.step1Desc: Import the Florida master catalog in one step — products, brands, categories, units, warehouses, prices, absence reasons, and optional Transaction Favorites by house model.
setup.step2Message: Set up the companies, crews, and places your jobs depend on.
setup.step2Desc: Builders and communities are required before Schedule can run. Crew categories, parties, and house models can be completed now or configured later.
setup.step2Warn: Add at least one builder and one community before you finish setup.
setup.step2Hint: You can explore the next step now. Finishing setup still needs a builder and a community.
setup.step3Message: Put your first job in motion — from schedule to contract.
setup.step3Desc: Learn by doing: schedule an event, assign materials with a Material Request, set piece-work prices, then generate your first contract.
setup.step3Hint: Add a builder and a community before marking setup complete.
setup.inventoryOptionalHint: Inventory is optional here. Import now, or continue and configure it later.
setup.finishBlocked: Add a builder and a community before marking setup complete.

about.heroTitle: Construction Operations Platform for Residential Trade Contractors
about.heroText: JobRhythm helps residential trade contractors centralize contracts, field operations, scheduling, inventory, and billing in one secure web platform.
about.metaTitle: Built for teams that need control
about.modulesIntro: The platform is organized around the operational needs of residential trade contractors. Each module is connected, so your team can move faster with fewer manual handoffs.

modules.title: Contract Management
modules.description: Manage bids, contract documents, revisions, and approvals with full traceability.

modules.title: Work Pricing
modules.description: Define and maintain trade pricing by builder, scope, and house model.

modules.title: Crew & Supervisor Scheduling
modules.description: Schedule field teams and supervisors using a visual calendar for faster coordination.

modules.title: Inventory Control
modules.description: Track stock, material movements, and warehouse balances in real time.

modules.title: Field Communication
modules.description: Coordinate office and field teams through contextual task communication.

modules.title: Notes & Job Documents
modules.description: Attach notes, photos, PDFs, and drawings to jobs and schedule events.

modules.title: Billing & Collections
modules.description: Connect completed work, contract scope, and billing records in one flow.

modules.title: Roles & Permissions
modules.description: Secure sensitive operations with role-based access by user and team.

about.flowIntro: A clear sequence from planning to closeout gives your office and field teams a repeatable process.

operationalFlow.title: Plan
operationalFlow.description: Create contract scope, define pricing, and prepare job documentation.

operationalFlow.title: Schedule
operationalFlow.description: Assign crews, supervisors, and equipment based on project priorities.

operationalFlow.title: Execute
operationalFlow.description: Run field activities with task context, notes, and real-time communication.

operationalFlow.title: Control
operationalFlow.description: Monitor inventory usage, progress status, and operational bottlenecks.

operationalFlow.title: Bill & Close
operationalFlow.description: Generate billing records and close jobs with complete operational history.

valuePoints.title: Single source of truth
valuePoints.description: Contracts, schedules, inventory, and billing data stay synchronized.

valuePoints.title: Faster decisions
valuePoints.description: Operational visibility helps managers resolve issues before they impact delivery.

valuePoints.title: Scalable operations
valuePoints.description: Standardized workflows make it easier to grow teams without losing control.
